test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent Security change-default and project trust restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove one approved reversible security-policy change persists and restore the explicitly selected factory or project target without altering provisioned trust material or effective protections.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator plus security owner
DEFAULT_TARGET plus separate factory/project trust oracles
One reversible non-secret policy and prohibition list
Backup/key custody, incident and KVM/physical recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline menu and secret-safe trust state; change one approved reversible non-provisioning control, save/reboot and prove retained menu/effective state. Invoke approved Load Defaults and record factory state. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, restore through the approved custody process. Compare final Secure Boot key IDs, TPM/PCR policy, measured boot/attestation and protections to selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The approved policy persists; all phases meet signed boot/trust criteria; factory output is separate; final menu and effective security state exactly match selected Factory Default or Project Recipe without prohibited trust-material changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared target with row-specific menu and effective trust evidence. Factory cannot satisfy Project Recipe. Key/TPM/PCR/attestation/protection drift, boot rejection or wrong restoration is FAIL. Missing target/oracle/custody/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until security owner signs target, policy, trust oracle, custody and recovery.
No all/random, protection disable, TPM clear/ownership, key enroll/delete, fuse, provisioning, credential or secret change.
Back up project security state; preserve trust/event logs, redact secrets and use only this row's evidence.
Operator/security owner control save/reboot/default/restoration/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24/security-owner approval and security identity
Declared target, factory/project oracle, reversible policy and prohibition list
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, restoration and final screenshots
Secret-safe Secure Boot key IDs, TPM/PCR/provisioning, measured-boot/attestation/protection comparisons
Backup/restored trust state, discrepancy/incident/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on trust drift or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Security owner uses only signed custody/project recovery; do not clear TPM, mutate keys, disable protection, reuse row 2180 evidence or blindly retry.
